info.name: ShopSphere API (Module 5)
info.description: End-to-end tests for the ShopSphere MERN e-commerce API: JWT auth, RBAC, profile & cart, product CRUD with filtering/sorting/search, orders, RapidMiner analytics and contact. Run against a freshly seeded database (npm run seed) with the server on port 5050: npm run test:api. Requests chain ids and tokens through collection variables and clean up what they create.

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Health check and the tokens used by the rest of the run.

exec: pm.test("API and DB are up", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(b.db).to.eql("connected"); });
pm.test("User role, no password in response", () => { pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql("user"); pm.expect(b.user).to.not.have.property("password"); });

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token validation and logout (JWT + bcryptjs).

exec: pm.test("Token and user returned; role forced to user", () => { pm.expect(b.token).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql("user"); pm.expect(b.user).to.not.have.property("password"); });
pm.test("Errors for name, email, password", () => { const f = pm.response.json().errors.map((e) => e.field); pm.expect(f).to.include.members(["name", "email", "password"]); });

item.name: 2. Users & profile
item.description: Profile CRUD, saved cart and admin user management (RBAC).

exec: pm.test("Address saved", () => { const u = pm.response.json().user; pm.expect(u.address.city).to.eql("Kochi"); pm.expect(u.phone).to.eql("+91 98765 43210"); });
pm.test("One valid line", () => { const c = pm.response.json().cart; pm.expect(c).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(c[0].quantity).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Finds the new shopper with pagination", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.users.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(b.pagination).to.have.property("total"); });

item.name: 3. Products
item.description: Public browsing with filtering, sorting, search and pagination; admin-only CRUD; reviews.

exec: pm.test("12 per page with pagination", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.products.length).to.be.at.most(12); pm.expect(b.pagination).to.include.keys("page", "limit", "total", "pages"); });
pm.test("Results mention phone", () => { const p = pm.response.json().products; pm.expect(p.length).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Filter category + price range, sort price_asc

exec: pm.test("Filtered and sorted", () => { const p = pm.response.json().products; p.forEach((x) => { pm.expect(x.category).to.eql("smartphones"); pm.expect(x.price).to.be.within(10000, 100000); }); for (let i = 1; i < p.length; i++) pm.expect(p[i].price).to.be.at.least(p[i - 1].price); });
pm.test("Rating >= 4, in stock", () => pm.response.json().products.forEach((x) => { pm.expect(x.rating).to.be.at.least(4); pm.expect(x.stock).to.be.above(0); }));
pm.test("Categories with counts", () => { const c = pm.response.json().categories; pm.expect(c.length).to.be.above(5); pm.expect(c[0]).to.have.keys("name", "count"); });

exec: pm.test("Rating recalculated", () => { const p = pm.response.json().product; pm.expect(p.numReviews).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.rating).to.eql(4); });

item.name: 4. Orders
item.description: Checkout with server-side pricing and stock reservation, order tracking, admin status workflow.

exec: pm.test("Server-side prices (client price ignored)", () => { pm.expect(o.itemsPrice).to.eql(2398); pm.expect(o.shippingPrice).to.eql(0); pm.expect(o.totalPrice).to.eql(2398); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("pending"); });

pm.test("Pending only, user populated", () => { const o = pm.response.json().orders; pm.expect(o.length).to.be.above(0); o.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.status).to.eql("pending")); pm.expect(o[0].user).to.have.property("email"); });

item.name: 5. Analytics & RapidMiner recommendations
item.description: Behaviour tracking, recommendations with fallback sources, RapidMiner CSV export/import, admin dashboard.

exec: pm.test("Six popular products", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.source).to.eql("popular"); pm.expect(b.strategy).to.eql("trending"); pm.expect(b.products).to.have.length(6); });

pm.test("Personalised with reasons", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.strategy).to.eql("personalized"); pm.expect(["builtin-cf", "rapidminer", "rapidminer-live"]).to.include(b.source); pm.expect(b.products).to.have.length(8); pm.expect(b.products[0]).to.have.property("reason"); });

pm.test("Six items, not the product itself", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.products).to.have.length(6); pm.expect(b.products.map((p) => p._id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("productId")); });
pm.test("1 pair imported, unknown id skipped", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.imported).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.skipped).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.products).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Similar products now from RapidMiner model

exec: pm.test("source rapidminer, imported neighbour first", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.source).to.eql("rapidminer"); pm.expect(b.products[0]._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("secondProductId")); });
pm.test("RapidMiner model active", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.activeSource).to.eql("rapidminer"); pm.expect(b.interactions.total).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test("Totals and all statuses", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.totals).to.include.keys("users", "products", "orders", "revenue"); pm.expect(b.ordersByStatus).to.have.keys("pending", "processing", "shipped", "delivered", "cancelled"); });
